source_quotes.conditions: BV-2 microglia subjected to LPS administration (1 μg/mL) were treated with LIPUS stimulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].target.label: BV-2 cells are derived from primary mouse microglia cells and are the most frequently used substitute for primary microglia. A BV-2 microglia cell line was purchased from American Type Culture Collection (ATCC).
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: The LIPUS was generated by a therapeutic ultrasound generator (ME740, Mettler Electronics) and a 1-MHz plane transducer (ME7410: 9.3 cm<sup>2</sup> effective radiating area; Mettler Electronics) with 5-ms burst length at a 50% duty cycle and a repetition frequency of 100 Hz.

flags.reason: Paper states this as 'spatial average intensity' (SATA, averaged over the transducer face), not a spatial-peak measure; placed in ispta_w_cm2 as the closest schema field but the domain/measure type does not exactly match ISPTA.

Paper reports only technical/biological replicate counts per assay (n=6 for most figures, n=4 for inhibitor experiments in Fig. 5) and never a total number of independent culture preparations for the study.

species: mouse (BV-2 microglia cell line); rat (CTX TNA2 astrocyte cell line, comparison only)
readout_other: Western blot quantification of BDNF, GDNF, VEGF, p-TrkB, p-Akt, p-CREB, TLR4, MyD88, phosphorylated JNK, phosphorylated NF-κB p65, iNOS, COX-2, TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, Bax, Bcl-2; MTT cell viability assay
direction_notes: LIPUS enhanced BDNF/GDNF/CREB/TrkB/Akt expression while suppressing LPS-induced proinflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β, IL-6, iNOS, COX-2) and Bax/Bcl-2 apoptosis ratio; this is a molecular/inflammatory readout rather than a neural excitability measure, so direction_of_effect is not scored as excitatory/inhibitory.

exposures.label: LIPUS stimulation of BV-2 microglia (and comparison astrocyte culture)

target.label: BV-2 microglial cells (cultured); CTX TNA2 astrocytes (cultured, comparison)

device.model: ME740 generator with ME7410 1-MHz plane transducer

timing.protocol_description: Each sample of microglial cells was treated with multiple LIPUS stimulations by triple sonication. Each sonication lasted 5 min, with a 5-min interval between the first and second and between the second and third sonications, for a total sonication time of 15 min.
